name: Fortis Racing Gear
description: Precision-engineered racing equipment for ultimate performance.
story: Fortis Racing Gear was founded by former motorsport engineers who saw a need for better, more reliable equipment. They are committed to providing drivers with the tools they need to win, and view motorsport sponsorships as a way to showcase their products under the most demanding conditions. Fortis seeks partnerships with teams demonstrating a commitment to innovation and peak performance.
